# Documentation and Reports

Follow the `Documentation and Reports` section in the root `AGENTS.md` file.
That section is the canonical ASD-STE100 rule for all documentation and
reports.

Apply it to new text and to text that you change.
Apply it to plans, reviews, issue text, pull request text, and release notes.

Use synthetic names, messages, ETAs, and mission data in examples.
Do not paste secrets, production payloads, or private mission artifacts.
Do not describe Respondr Lite as an autonomous dispatch or safety system.
